column2:
sack(n.)大袋子、麻袋
(無詞性變化)
a sack of rice 一袋米
get the sack 被開除
The farmer carried a heavy sack of rice on his back.
(農夫背著一大袋沉重的米。)
He got the sack for being late too often.
(他因為太常遲到而被開除了。)

sake(n.)緣故、利益
(無詞性變化)
for the sake of 為了……
for one's own sake 為了某人自己好
She quit smoking for the sake of her children.
(她為了孩子而戒菸。)
Please get some rest for your own sake.
(為了你自己好，請休息一下。)

salary(n.)薪水、薪資
salaried(adj.)領薪水的
monthly salary 月薪
raise one's salary 加薪
His monthly salary is enough to support his family.
(他的月薪足夠養家。)
The company decided to raise everyone's salary this year.
(公司決定今年替每個人加薪。)

satisfactory(adj.)令人滿意的、符合要求的
satisfy(v.)使滿意
satisfaction(n.)滿意
satisfactory result 令人滿意的結果
satisfactory answer 滿意的答覆
The test results were satisfactory.
(考試結果令人滿意。)
He could not give a satisfactory answer to the question.
(他無法對這個問題給出令人滿意的答覆。)

sauce(n.)醬汁、調味醬
saucer(n.)茶碟、淺碟
soy sauce 醬油
tomato sauce 番茄醬汁
Add a little soy sauce to the fried rice.
(在炒飯裡加一點醬油。)
The pasta tastes better with fresh tomato sauce.
(義大利麵配上新鮮番茄醬汁更好吃。)

saucer(n.)茶碟、淺碟
sauce(n.)醬汁
cup and saucer 一套杯碟
flying saucer 飛碟
She placed the cup carefully on the saucer.
(她小心地把杯子放在茶碟上。)
The boy claimed he saw a flying saucer in the sky.
(那個男孩聲稱他在天空看到了飛碟。)

sausage(n.)香腸、臘腸
(無詞性變化)
grilled sausage 烤香腸
sausage roll 香腸捲
Grilled sausage is a popular snack at Taiwan's night markets.
(烤香腸是台灣夜市受歡迎的小吃。)
We had eggs and sausages for breakfast.
(我們早餐吃了蛋和香腸。)

saving(n.)節省、savings(n.)存款、積蓄
save(v.)節省、儲蓄、拯救
savings account 儲蓄帳戶
life savings 畢生積蓄
She spent all her savings on a trip to Japan.
(她把所有的積蓄都花在日本之旅上。)
Turning off the lights can make a big saving on electricity.
(隨手關燈可以省下大量電費。)

scale(n.)規模、比例、刻度、scales(n.)秤、天平
(無詞性變化)
on a large scale 大規模地
bathroom scales 體重計
The company produces toys on a large scale.
(那間公司大規模生產玩具。)
She stepped on the scales to check her weight.
(她站上體重計量體重。)

scarce(adj.)稀少的、缺乏的
scarcely(adv.)幾乎不
scarcity(n.)缺乏、稀少
scarce resources 稀少的資源
water is scarce 水資源缺乏
Water becomes scarce in the dry season.
(乾季時水變得很缺乏。)
Food was scarce during the war.
(戰爭期間糧食短缺。)

scarf(n.)圍巾、披巾
scarves(n.)圍巾(複數)
wool scarf 羊毛圍巾
wear a scarf 圍圍巾
She wore a warm wool scarf on the cold day.
(她在寒冷的日子圍著一條溫暖的羊毛圍巾。)
My grandmother knitted a scarf for me.
(我奶奶替我織了一條圍巾。)

scary(adj.)可怕的、嚇人的
scare(v./n.)驚嚇、恐慌
scared(adj.)害怕的
scary movie 恐怖電影
scary experience 可怕的經歷
We watched a scary movie last night and couldn't sleep.
(我們昨晚看了一部恐怖片，結果睡不著。)
Being stuck in the elevator was a scary experience.
(被困在電梯裡是一次可怕的經歷。)

scatter(v./n.)散布、撒、驅散
scattered(adj.)分散的、零星的
scatter seeds 撒種子
scattered showers 零星陣雨
The farmer scattered seeds across the field.
(農夫在田裡撒下種子。)
Toys were scattered all over the floor.
(玩具散落了一地。)

scholar(n.)學者
scholarship(n.)獎學金
scholarly(adj.)學術的、博學的
famous scholar 知名學者
Chinese scholar 漢學家
He is a famous scholar of Chinese history.
(他是一位知名的中國史學者。)
Many scholars came to the conference to share their research.
(許多學者來參加研討會分享研究。)

scholarship(n.)獎學金
scholar(n.)學者
win a scholarship 獲得獎學金
full scholarship 全額獎學金
She won a full scholarship to study in the US.
(她獲得全額獎學金到美國留學。)
Good grades can help you get a scholarship.
(好成績可以幫助你獲得獎學金。)

scientific(adj.)科學的
science(n.)科學
scientifically(adv.)科學地
scientific research 科學研究
scientific method 科學方法
The scientific method helps us find answers step by step.
(科學方法幫助我們一步一步找到答案。)
There is no scientific evidence for the story.
(這個說法沒有科學證據。)

scientist(n.)科學家
science(n.)科學
scientific(adj.)科學的
computer scientist 電腦科學家
become a scientist 成為科學家
My little brother wants to become a scientist.
(我弟弟想成為科學家。)
Scientists are working hard to find a cure for the disease.
(科學家正努力尋找治療這種疾病的方法。)

scissors(n.)剪刀
(無詞性變化)
a pair of scissors 一把剪刀
sharp scissors 鋒利的剪刀
Can I borrow your scissors to cut the paper?
(我可以借你的剪刀剪紙嗎？)
Children should be careful when using sharp scissors.
(小孩使用鋒利的剪刀時應該小心。)

scout(n./v.)童子軍、偵察員、偵察
(無詞性變化)
boy scout 童子軍
talent scout 星探
My brother joined the scouts in junior high school.
(我哥哥國中時參加了童子軍。)
A talent scout noticed her singing in the park.
(一位星探注意到她在公園唱歌。)

scream(v./n.)尖叫、大叫
(無詞性變化)
scream for help 尖叫求救
let out a scream 發出一聲尖叫
She screamed when she saw a big spider.
(她看到一隻大蜘蛛時尖叫起來。)
We heard someone scream for help outside.
(我們聽到外面有人尖叫求救。)

screw(v./n.)旋緊、用螺絲固定、螺絲
screwdriver(n.)螺絲起子
tighten a screw 鎖緊螺絲
screw up 搞砸
He used a screwdriver to tighten the screws.
(他用螺絲起子鎖緊螺絲。)
I really screwed up my math test.
(我數學考試真的考砸了。)

scrub(n./v.)刷洗、擦洗、灌木叢
(無詞性變化)
scrub the floor 刷地板
give a good scrub 好好刷洗
We scrubbed the classroom floor before the holiday.
(我們在放假前把教室地板刷洗乾淨。)
The pot needs a good scrub.
(這個鍋子需要好好刷洗。)

seal(n./v.)海豹、封條、印章、密封
(無詞性變化)
seal the envelope 封好信封
baby seal 小海豹
Don't forget to seal the envelope before mailing it.
(寄出前別忘了把信封封好。)
We watched seals playing on the rocks.
(我們看著海豹在岩石上玩耍。)

security(n.)安全、保全、保障
secure(adj./v.)安全的、確保
security guard 保全人員
security check 安全檢查
All passengers must go through a security check.
(所有乘客都必須通過安全檢查。)
The building has twenty-four-hour security.
(這棟大樓有二十四小時保全。)

semester(n.)學期
(無詞性變化)
fall semester 上學期
final exam of the semester 期末考
The new semester starts in September.
(新學期在九月開始。)
I plan to join the drama club this semester.
(我打算這學期加入戲劇社。)

senior(adj./n.)年長的、資深的、高年級生、長者
seniority(n.)年資
senior high school 高中
senior citizen 年長者
My sister is a senior in high school.
(我姊姊是高三學生。)
Senior citizens can take the MRT at a lower price.
(年長者可以用較低的價格搭捷運。)

sensible(adj.)明智的、合理的
sense(n.)感覺、判斷力
sensibly(adv.)明智地
sensible decision 明智的決定
sensible shoes 實用好走的鞋子
It was a sensible decision to bring an umbrella.
(帶雨傘是個明智的決定。)
Wear sensible shoes for the long walk.
(長途步行要穿好走的鞋子。)

separation(n.)分開、分離
separate(v./adj.)分開、分開的
separately(adv.)分開地
separation from 與……分離
separation of powers 三權分立
The children cried at the separation from their parents.
(孩子們和父母分開時哭了。)
After years of separation, the two brothers finally met again.
(分離多年後，兩兄弟終於重逢。)

sexual(adj.)性的、性別的
sex(n.)性別、性
sexuality(n.)性向、性慾
sexual harassment 性騷擾
sexual equality 性別平等
Our school has clear rules against sexual harassment.
(我們學校有反性騷擾的明確規定。)
The class discussed sexual equality in the workplace.
(班上討論職場中的性別平等。)

sexy(adj.)性感的、迷人的
sex(n.)性別、性
sexy voice 性感的嗓音
look sexy 看起來性感
The singer is famous for her sexy voice.
(那位歌手以性感的嗓音聞名。)
Some people think fast cars are sexy.
(有些人覺得跑車很有魅力。)

shadow(n./v.)影子、陰影、跟蹤
shadowy(adj.)陰暗的、模糊的
in the shadow of 在……的陰影下
cast a shadow 投下陰影
The tall building casts a long shadow in the afternoon.
(這棟高樓在下午投下長長的影子。)
He grew up in the shadow of his famous brother.
(他在知名哥哥的光環下長大。)

shallow(adj.)淺的、膚淺的
(無詞性變化)
shallow water 淺水
shallow person 膚淺的人
Children should swim in shallow water.
(小孩應該在淺水區游泳。)
It is shallow to judge people only by their looks.
(只憑外表評斷別人是很膚淺的。)

shampoo(n./v.)洗髮精、洗頭
(無詞性變化)
a bottle of shampoo 一瓶洗髮精
shampoo and conditioner 洗髮精和潤髮乳
I need to buy a new bottle of shampoo.
(我需要買一瓶新的洗髮精。)
She shampoos her hair every night.
(她每天晚上洗頭。)

shepherd(n.)牧羊人
(無詞性變化)
German shepherd 德國牧羊犬
good shepherd 好牧人
The shepherd led his sheep across the hill.
(牧羊人帶著羊群越過山丘。)
Our neighbor keeps a German shepherd as a guard dog.
(我們的鄰居養了一隻德國牧羊犬當看門狗。)

shiny(adj.)閃亮的、有光澤的
shine(v./n.)發光、光澤
shiny hair 有光澤的頭髮
shiny new car 閃亮的新車
He drove a shiny new car to the party.
(他開著一輛閃亮的新車去參加派對。)
Her long hair is soft and shiny.
(她的長髮柔順又有光澤。)

shorten(v.)縮短、變短
short(adj.)短的
shortly(adv.)不久
shorten the time 縮短時間
shorten a skirt 改短裙子
The new bridge will shorten the travel time.
(新的橋梁將縮短交通時間。)
Please shorten your speech to three minutes.
(請把你的演講縮短到三分鐘。)

shortly(adv.)不久、立刻
short(adj.)短的
shortly after 在……之後不久
shortly before 在……之前不久
The train will arrive shortly.
(火車很快就會到站。)
Shortly after the game started, it began to rain.
(比賽開始後不久就下起雨了。)

shovel(n./v.)鏟子、用鏟子挖
(無詞性變化)
shovel snow 鏟雪
dig with a shovel 用鏟子挖
They shoveled snow off the road in the morning.
(他們早上把路上的雪鏟掉。)
He dug a hole in the garden with a shovel.
(他用鏟子在花園挖了一個洞。)

shrimp(n.)蝦子
(無詞性變化)
fried shrimp 炸蝦
shrimp fried rice 蝦仁炒飯
I ordered shrimp fried rice for dinner.
(我晚餐點了蝦仁炒飯。)
Some people are allergic to shrimp.
(有些人對蝦子過敏。)

shrink(v.)縮小、縮水、退縮
shrinkage(n.)收縮、縮水
shrink in the wash 洗後縮水
shrink from 逃避、退縮
My new sweater shrank in the wash.
(我的新毛衣洗了之後縮水了。)
The number of farmers in the village continues to shrink.
(村裡的農夫人數持續減少。)

sigh(n./v.)嘆氣、嘆息
(無詞性變化)
sigh of relief 鬆了一口氣
sigh deeply 深深地嘆氣
She breathed a sigh of relief after the exam.
(考完試後她鬆了一口氣。)
He sighed and looked out the window.
(他嘆了一口氣，望向窗外。)

signal(n./v.)信號、訊號、發信號
(無詞性變化)
traffic signal 交通號誌
no signal 沒有訊號
There is no phone signal in the mountains.
(山裡沒有手機訊號。)
The coach signaled the players to stop.
(教練示意球員停下來。)

significant(adj.)重要的、顯著的、有意義的
significance(n.)重要性、意義
significantly(adv.)顯著地
significant change 重大的改變
significant role 重要的角色
Social media plays a significant role in teenagers' lives.
(社群媒體在青少年的生活中扮演重要角色。)
There has been a significant increase in online shopping.
(網路購物有顯著的增加。)

silk(n.)絲、絲綢
silky(adj.)柔滑如絲的
silk scarf 絲巾
Silk Road 絲路
My mother bought a silk scarf in Thailand.
(我媽媽在泰國買了一條絲巾。)
The Silk Road connected China with Europe long ago.
(很久以前，絲路連接了中國與歐洲。)

similarity(n.)相似、相似處
similar(adj.)相似的
similarly(adv.)同樣地
similarity between ……之間的相似處
bear a similarity to 與……相似
There are many similarities between the two languages.
(這兩種語言之間有許多相似處。)
The twins bear a strong similarity to their father.
(這對雙胞胎長得很像他們的父親。)

sin(n./v.)罪、罪過、犯罪
sinful(adj.)有罪的
sinner(n.)罪人
commit a sin 犯罪
original sin 原罪
In some religions, lying is considered a sin.
(在某些宗教裡，說謊被視為一種罪。)
It's a sin to waste so much good food.
(浪費這麼多好食物真是罪過。)

sincere(adj.)真誠的、誠摯的
sincerely(adv.)真誠地、誠摯地
sincerity(n.)真誠
sincere apology 誠摯的道歉
sincere thanks 由衷的感謝
Please accept my sincere apology.
(請接受我誠摯的道歉。)
She gave him a sincere smile.
(她給了他一個真誠的微笑。)

sink(n./v.)水槽、洗手台、下沉
(無詞性變化)
kitchen sink 廚房水槽
sink to the bottom 沉到底部
Please put the dirty dishes in the sink.
(請把髒碗盤放進水槽。)
The ship hit a rock and began to sink.
(那艘船撞上岩石，開始下沉。)

sip(v./n.)啜飲、小口喝
(無詞性變化)
take a sip 喝一小口
sip tea 啜飲茶
She took a sip of hot tea and smiled.
(她喝了一小口熱茶，露出微笑。)
We sat on the balcony sipping coffee.
(我們坐在陽台上慢慢喝咖啡。)

situation(n.)情況、處境、形勢
situated(adj.)位於……的
difficult situation 困境
in this situation 在這種情況下
What would you do in this situation?
(在這種情況下你會怎麼做？)
She stayed calm in a difficult situation.
(她在困境中保持冷靜。)

skate(v./n.)溜冰、溜冰鞋
skater(n.)溜冰者
skating(n.)溜冰
ice skate 溜冰
roller skates 直排輪鞋
We went ice skating at the mall last weekend.
(上週末我們去購物中心溜冰。)
She skates very well for her age.
(以她的年紀來說，她溜冰溜得很好。)

ski(n./v.)滑雪板、滑雪
skier(n.)滑雪者
skiing(n.)滑雪
go skiing 去滑雪
ski resort 滑雪勝地
We plan to go skiing in Japan this winter.
(我們計劃今年冬天去日本滑雪。)
He learned to ski when he was ten.
(他十歲時學會滑雪。)

skillful(adj.)熟練的、有技巧的
skill(n.)技能
skillfully(adv.)熟練地
skillful player 技術純熟的選手
skillful at 擅長……
He is a skillful player on the basketball team.
(他是籃球隊裡技術純熟的球員。)
My grandmother is skillful at making dumplings.
(我奶奶很擅長包水餃。)

skinny(adj.)極瘦的、皮包骨的、緊身的
skin(n.)皮膚
skinny jeans 緊身牛仔褲
tall and skinny 又高又瘦
He was tall and skinny when he was a teenager.
(他青少年時又高又瘦。)
Skinny jeans were very popular a few years ago.
(緊身牛仔褲幾年前非常流行。)

skip(v./n.)跳過、略過、蹺(課)、蹦跳
(無詞性變化)
skip class 蹺課
skip breakfast 不吃早餐
It's not healthy to skip breakfast.
(不吃早餐是不健康的。)
If you don't know the answer, skip the question.
(如果你不知道答案，就跳過那一題。)

slave(n./v.)奴隸、苦幹
slavery(n.)奴隸制度
slave trade 奴隸買賣
slave to 受……支配的人
Abraham Lincoln worked to free the slaves.
(林肯致力於解放奴隸。)
Don't become a slave to your cell phone.
(不要被你的手機給綁架了。)

sleeve(n.)袖子
sleeveless(adj.)無袖的
long sleeves 長袖
roll up one's sleeves 捲起袖子、準備大幹一場
It's cold today, so wear a shirt with long sleeves.
(今天很冷，穿件長袖襯衫吧。)
Let's roll up our sleeves and clean the classroom.
(我們捲起袖子來打掃教室吧。)

slender(adj.)苗條的、纖細的
(無詞性變化)
slender figure 苗條的身材
slender fingers 纖細的手指
The dancer has a tall, slender figure.
(那位舞者身材高挑苗條。)
She played the piano with her long, slender fingers.
(她用修長纖細的手指彈鋼琴。)

slice(n./v.)薄片、一片、切片
(無詞性變化)
a slice of bread 一片麵包
slice the cake 切蛋糕
I had a slice of bread and a cup of milk for breakfast.
(我早餐吃了一片麵包和一杯牛奶。)
My mother sliced the cake into eight pieces.
(我媽媽把蛋糕切成八塊。)

slippery(adj.)滑的、易滑的
slip(v./n.)滑倒、滑
slippery floor 滑溜的地板
slippery road 濕滑的路面
Be careful, the floor is slippery after cleaning.
(小心，地板剛拖過很滑。)
The roads are slippery on rainy days.
(雨天路面很濕滑。)

slope(n.)斜坡、坡度
sloping(adj.)傾斜的
steep slope 陡坡
ski slope 滑雪坡道
The house was built on a steep slope.
(那棟房子蓋在陡坡上。)
The children ran down the grassy slope.
(孩子們跑下長滿青草的斜坡。)

snap(v./n.)啪地折斷、猛咬、厲聲說、快照
(無詞性變化)
snap one's fingers 彈手指
snap at 厲聲責罵
The branch snapped under his weight.
(樹枝被他的體重壓得啪一聲斷了。)
I'm sorry I snapped at you this morning.
(很抱歉我今天早上對你大聲說話。)

solid(adj.)固體的、堅固的、可靠的

under suspicion 受到懷疑
arouse suspicion 引起懷疑
His strange behavior aroused the guard's suspicion.
(他奇怪的舉動引起警衛的懷疑。)
The new worker is under suspicion of stealing money.
(那位新員工涉嫌偷錢。)

swan(n.)天鵝
(無詞性變化)
black swan 黑天鵝
Swan Lake 天鵝湖
Two white swans were swimming on the lake.
(兩隻白天鵝在湖上游著。)
We watched the ballet Swan Lake last night.
(我們昨晚看了芭蕾舞劇《天鵝湖》。)

swear(v.)發誓、咒罵
swearing(n.)咒罵、發誓
swear to 對……發誓
swear at 咒罵某人
I swear I didn't tell anyone your secret.
(我發誓我沒有把你的秘密告訴任何人。)
It's rude to swear at other people.
(對別人罵髒話很沒禮貌。)

sweat(n./v.)汗水、流汗
sweaty(adj.)汗濕的
break a sweat 流汗
no sweat 小事一樁
I was covered in sweat after running.
(跑步後我滿身大汗。)
Can you help me move this desk? No sweat.
(你可以幫我搬這張桌子嗎？小事一樁。)

swell(v./n.)腫脹、增大、膨脹
swelling(n.)腫脹處
swollen(adj.)腫起來的
swell up 腫起來
swollen ankle 腫脹的腳踝
My ankle began to swell after I fell down.
(我跌倒後腳踝開始腫起來。)
The river swelled after days of heavy rain.
(連日大雨後河水暴漲。)

swift(adj.)迅速的、敏捷的
swiftly(adv.)迅速地
swift action 迅速的行動
swift reply 迅速的回覆
Thanks to the firefighters' swift action, no one was hurt.
(多虧消防員迅速行動，沒有人受傷。)
The swift river is dangerous for swimmers.
(湍急的河流對游泳者很危險。)

sword(n.)劍、刀
(無詞性變化)
draw a sword 拔劍
double-edged sword 雙面刃
The knight drew his sword to fight the dragon.
(騎士拔劍與龍搏鬥。)
The Internet is a double-edged sword.
(網路是一把雙面刃。)
